metadata.description: A tiny toolkit for the ADHD brain working inside Claude Code: break tasks down, capture stray thoughts without losing your place, and recover context after a distraction.

plugins.name: focus-mode
plugins.description: Turn a vague, overwhelming task into one tiny next step. Time-box it, and park distractions instead of chasing them.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Empty a racing mind onto the page, then let Claude sort the noise into real tasks, notes, and things to ignore.

plugins.name: where-was-i
plugins.description: Drop a breadcrumb before you get pulled away, and pick the thread back up when you return. Rescue for interrupted work.

plugins.name: body-double
plugins.description: A calm co-working companion that keeps you gently on task without nagging. Body-doubling for coding sessions.
